reuse.why: Consolidates the existing per-action category queries into getMonthWideCategories and a forEachMonthWideCategory loop and keeps using setBudget/setNMonthAvg/getCategoryAverage, though the template check is a raw goal_def IS NULL rather than going through the goal-template module's notion of a saved template.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the visible-category query and loop; only copyPreviousMonth keeps its own loop that repeats the income/tracking-budget skip.

placement.why: The selection function and iterator live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the dropped getBudgetData helper they no longer need, and tests.

maintainability.why: One documented definition of which categories month-wide actions may touch; the separate copyPreviousMonth loop is a small seam where the income rule could drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through getMonthWideCategories; copyPreviousMonth skips only the new iterator, not the selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The income check left in copyPreviousMonth is a plain repeated line, not a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden/hidden-group/saved-template exclusion and is used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
